Read the notebooks in order: each part builds on the one before it. Every part is a runnable
Jupyter notebook with the code, outputs and charts included.

::: {.track-facts}
**You'll learn**: how to break a series into trend, seasonality and noise; how to test and fix
non-stationarity; and how to fit and compare AR, MA, ARMA, ARIMA and SARIMA forecasting models.

**Prerequisites**: Python and pandas basics, and introductory statistics (mean, variance,
correlation).

**Tools**: pandas, NumPy, statsmodels, scikit-learn, matplotlib, yfinance.
:::
